const readmeConfig = {
    name: "react-approval-flow",
    summary: "<p>审批流程设计器：基于 <code>@kne/react-flow-chart</code> 的树形流程图，编辑审批、办理、抄送、条件分支、并行分支节点；审批节点支持会签 / 或签 / 依次 / 按比例通过、加签、超时、驳回退回、空审批人与自审规则，可内嵌 <code>@kne/form-creator</code> 补充表单并把字段映射为共享变量。</p>\n<p>分支条件只能引用一定会经过的上游数据：发起数据 <code>input</code>、发起人 <code>initiator</code>、上游节点表单 <code>nodes.&lt;key&gt;</code> 与共享变量 <code>vars.&lt;key&gt;</code>。包内同时导出无 UI 的核心函数（上下文 Schema 推导、条件求值、流程校验），可在后端复用同一套规则。</p>",
    description: "审批流程设计器：树形流程图编辑审批、办理、抄送、条件分支、并行分支节点，节点内嵌 form-creator 补充表单，基于流程上下文编辑分支条件，并提供流程校验、上下文 Schema 推导与运行状态预览",
    keywords: ["approval","workflow","flow-designer","审批流","流程设计器","条件分支","并行分支","form-creator","react"],
    packageName: "@kne/react-approval-flow",
    api: "<h4>ApprovalFlowDesigner</h4>\n<p>审批流程设计器（默认导出）。点击节点打开配置弹窗，配置弹窗与节点补充表单设计都通过 <code>@kne/form-info</code> 的 <code>FormModal</code> 渲染。</p>\n<h5>属性</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>value</td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>流程图（受控），格式见下方「流程图数据」；传空数组时显示只有开始、结束节点的默认流程</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>defaultValue</td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>流程图初始值（非受控）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>onChange</td>\n<td>function(graph)</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>流程图变化回调</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>inputSchema</td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>功能声明的输入数据 JSON Schema，作为上下文中的 <code>input</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>displaySchema</td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>发起时附带的展示区块 <code>{ blocks: [{ key, title }] }</code>，决定可选的审批人来源</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>pickers</td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>选择器 <code>{ user, role, dept }</code>，每项可为 <code>{ loadOptions(keyword) =&gt; Promise&lt;[{ value, label     code: "const { default: ApprovalFlowDesigner, createFormDataSchema } = _ReactApprovalFlow;\nconst { createBlock, createField, defaultSchema } = _FormCreator;\nconst { Flex, Typography, Segmented, createBlock('formInfo', {\n      title: '复核信息',\n      column: 1,\n      list: [\n        createField({ type: 'InputNumber', name: 'approvedAmount', label: '核定金额', rule: 'REQ' }),\n }\n];\n\nconst searchFrom = list => keyword => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve(list.filter(item => item.label.indexOf(keyword) > -1)), 300));\n\n// 功能声明「费用报销」的 inputSchema\nconst inputSchema = {\n  type: 'object',\n  title: '报销单',\n  properties: {\n    amount: { type: 'number', title: '报销金额' },\n    category: { type: 'string', title: '费用类型', enum: ['travel', 'entertain', '费用明细' },\n    { key: 'attachments', title: '发票附件' }\n  ]\n};\n\nconst defaultValue = [\n  { id: 'start', key: 'start', type: 'start', title: '发起人' },\n  {\n    id: 'n_leader',\n    key: 'leader',\n    type: 'approval',\n    title: '直属上级审批',\n    config: {\n      approvers: [{ source: 'superior', level: 1 }],\n      mode: 'or',\n      emptyPolicy: 'toAdmin',\n      selfPolicy: 'autoPass',\n      dedupe: 'once',\n      rejectAction: 'returnInitiator',\n      timeout: { enabled: true, duration: 24, action: 'remind', workdayOnly: true }\n    }\n  },\n  {\n    id: 'n_finance',\n    key: 'finance',\n    type: 'approval',\n    title: '财务复核',\n    config: {\n      approvers: [{ source: 'role', items: [roles[0]] }],\n      mode: 'or',\n      form: {\n        enabled: true,\n        fillOn: ['approve'],\n        schema: financeFormSchema,\n        dataSchema: createFormDataSchema(financeFormSchema)\n      },\n      contextMapping: [{ field: 'approvedAmount', target: {\n          id: 'n_ceo',\n          key: 'ceo',\n          type: 'approval',\n          title: '总经理审批',\n          config: { approvers: [{ source: 'role', items: [roles[2]] }], mode: 'or' }\n        }\n      ],\n      [{ id: 'b_default', type: 'branch', title: '其他', config: { isDefault: true } }]\n    ]\n  },\n  {\n    id: 'n_parallel',\n    type: 'parallel',\n    title: '并行办理',\n    config: { joinRule: 'all', branchRejectRule: 'rejectInstance' },\n    children: [\n      [\n        { id: 'p_pay', type: 'branch', title: '出纳付款', config: {} },\n        { id: 'n_pay', key: 'pay', type:     code: "const { validateFlow, hasBlockingIssue, buildContextSchema, getContextScope } = _ReactApprovalFlow;\nconst { Flex, Card, List, Tag, Typography } = antd;\nconst { useMemo } = React;\n\nconst config: { joinRule: 'count', joinCount: 3 },\n    children: [\n      [{ id: 'p1', type: 'branch', config: {} }, { id: 'n_hr', key: 'review', type: 'handle', title: '人事办理', config: { approvers: [] } [{ id: 'b_check', type: 'branch', config: { condition: { logic: 'and', rules: [{ field: 'vars.approvedAmount', op: 'gt', value: 10000 }] } } }],\n      [{ id: 'b_else', type: 'branch', config: {
